description: Source code for ImportNoteDialog class handling import of notes, images, and attachments from Evernote export files, including HTML entity decoding and file management.

classes.name: ImportNoteDialog
classes.description: Dialog class for importing notes from Evernote export files, handling UI setup, parsing XML data, importing images and attachments, and decoding HTML entities.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes file dialog, connects file selection to import process, and sets up progress bar.

methods.name: initProgressBar
methods.description: Counts notes in the XML data to set progress bar maximum.

methods.name: importNotes
methods.description: Parses XML data to extract notes, converts HTML content to markdown, imports images and attachments, and saves notes locally.

methods.name: importImages
methods.description: Extracts image resources from XML, replaces image tags with markdown links, and handles media data.

methods.name: importAttachments
methods.description: Extracts non-image resources, replaces media tags with markdown links, and saves files locally.

methods.name: getMarkdownForMediaFileData
methods.description: Saves media data to file and returns markdown image link.

methods.name: getMarkdownForAttachmentFileData
methods.description: Saves attachment data to file and returns markdown link.

methods.name: decodeHtmlEntities
methods.description: Decodes HTML entities in text to Unicode characters.

methods.name: showEvent
methods.description: Overrides show event to send screen view analytics.
